request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  400
warning[ZC-W0808]: the server started with --discard-sealed
  cause  --discard-sealed deleted 21 sealed record(s) and ACME order(s)
  cause  the old key file was renamed
         seal-0123456789abcdef.key.discarded-1763424000, beside the new one
         (docs/sealing.md says how to restore it)
  cause  a new sealing key was made, with id 9e3c71b05d4a2f86
  cause  every public host is ordered again, which counts against Let's
         Encrypt's limits: 50 certificates per registered domain per week and 5
         duplicates per week
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    back up the new key file; start without --discard-sealed from now on
  more   zcube explain W0808
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/W0808.html
